nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What spectrometer was used to analyze differences in surface elemental composition and speciation of Dicranopteris pedata REEs/C?
nodes.answer: Differences in surface elemental composition and speciation were analyzed using a Multifunctional imaging electron spectrometer (XPS, Thermo ESCALAB 250XI, Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA).

nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: What are the two categories of macroinvertebrates mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The two categories are pollution sensitive taxa (e.g., Leptophlebiidae, Siphlonuridae, Arctopsychidae, and Perlidae) and pollution tolerant taxa (e.g., Chironomidae, Lymnaeidae, Planorbidae, and Glossiphoniidae).
